description: This is a Java test class for the ContractService, containing unit tests that verify contract approval logic, supervisor assignment, and user acceptance behavior.

classes.name: ContractServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ContractService, testing supervisor approval flow and user acceptance logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock services and the ContractService instance before each test.

methods.name: given_contract_and_user_when_supervisor_can_accept_then_acceptedBy_supervisor
methods.description: Tests that a contract is accepted by the supervisor when the supervisor has sufficient contract approval limit.

methods.name: given_contract_and_user_when_supervisor_cant_accept_then_send_to_his_supervisor
methods.description: Tests that a contract is forwarded to the next supervisor if the current supervisor cannot approve it.

methods.name: given_user_who_can_accept_contract_then_contract_accepted
methods.description: Verifies that a user with approval rights can accept a contract.

methods.name: given_user_who_cant_accept_contract_then_contract_not_accepted
methods.description: Verifies that a user without approval rights cannot accept a contract.
